level_seven.description: If an entire ammo magazine is unloaded on an enemy within 2 seconds, the last bullet will deal 80 (+4% per level) bonus damage. This is equal to 35% of the total magazine.

level_ten.title: Sticky Bomb
level_ten.description: Increases Pulse Bomb's radius by 50% and enemies hit are Slowed by 70% for 3 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Jumper
level_thirteen.description: Passive: When Blink has no charges remaining, its cooldown refreshes 100% faster.  Casting Blink grants Tracer a Shield equal to 6% of her maximum Health for 3 seconds. This Shield stacks up to 3 times.

level_sixteen.title: Ricochet
level_sixteen.description: Tracer's Basic Attacks have a 60% chance to hit another nearby enemy, prioritizing Heroes.

level_twenty.title: Total Recall
level_twenty.description: Recall heals Tracer equal to the amount of Health she lost during that time.

level_one.title: War Paint
level_one.description: Sonya's Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

level_four.title: Hurricane
level_four.description: Reduce the cooldown of Whirlwind by 2 seconds. Casting Whirlwind removes all Slows and Roots from Sonya.

level_seven.title: Life Funnel
level_seven.description: Increases the healing of Whirlwind to 35% of damage dealt.

level_ten.title: Leap
level_ten.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Ruthless
level_thirteen.description: Whirlwind deals an additional 50 (+4% per level) damage per second to Heroes below 50% Health. Does not generate additional healing.

level_sixteen.title: Rampage
level_sixteen.description: Increase Basic Attack damage by 25%. Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Ancient Spear by 1.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Arreat Crater
level_twenty.description: Leap leaves behind an impassable crater for 5 seconds.  Reduces Leap's cooldown by 20 seconds.

level_one.title: Block Party
level_one.description: Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes a stack of Block, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next Hero Basic Attack for 8 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Maximum 2 stacks of Block.

level_four.title: Speed Metal
level_four.description: Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes 20% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Pinball Wizard
level_seven.description: Hitting an enemy with Powerslide causes the next Face Melt against them within 2 seconds to deal 300% more damage.

level_ten.title: Mosh Pit
level_ten.description: After 0.75 seconds, channel to stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Encore
level_thirteen.description: Face Melt leaves an Amp behind, which will knock enemies away again 2 seconds later.  Passive: Each enemy Hero hit by Face Melt or the Amp reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 4%.

level_sixteen.title: Show Stopper
level_sixteen.description: After using Powerslide, gain 35 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing all damage taken by 35%.

level_one.title: Smooth Moves
level_one.description: While Wall Ride is active, Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt and restore 0.5 Mana.  Passive: Increase Wall Ride duration by 1 second.

level_four.title: Off the Wall
level_four.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave while Wall Ride is active sets its cooldown to 5 seconds and refunds 15 Mana.

level_seven.title: Good Vibrations
level_seven.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave grants Lúcio a 38 (+4% per level) Shield for 8 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes grants 3 times this amount.

level_ten.title: Sound Barrier
level_ten.description: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1296 (+4% per level) point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Slip
level_thirteen.description: While Wall Ride is active, passing near an enemy Hero increases its Movement Speed bonus to 40%, and grants 15 Armor, for 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Rejuvenescência
level_sixteen.description: While Amp It Up is active, Crossfade's Healing Boost heals for an additional 2.5% of the target's maximum Health each second.

level_one.title: Ardent Restoration
level_one.description: Dealing damage to a Hero heals Tyrael for 20 (+4% per level) Health over 5 seconds. Dealing damage resets this timer, and the heal amount stacks up to 8 times.  Quest: Every Regeneration Globe gathered increases this heal amount by 1%.

level_four.title: Divine Vigor
level_four.description: If Smite hits an enemy, Tyrael's Basic Attacks within the next 4 seconds heal for 70% of the damage dealt.

level_seven.title: Swift Retribution
level_seven.description: Smite grants 20% more Movement Speed and also grants 25% Attack Speed for 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Judgment
level_ten.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75 (+4% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Sword of Justice
level_thirteen.description: Upon teleporting using El'druin's Might, El'druin swaps places with Tyrael, and El'druin's Might can be reactivated to teleport an additional time.

level_sixteen.title: Burning Halo
level_sixteen.description: Both Tyrael and El'druin deal 12 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Teleporting increases this damage from Tyrael by 125% for 2 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Angel of Justice
level_twenty.description: Increases the cast range of Judgment by 50%, and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.

level_one.title: Volatile Acid
level_one.description: Banelings can travel 50% further before exploding.

level_four.title: Medusa Blades
level_four.description: Basic Attacks deal 33% damage to three nearby targets.

level_seven.title: Baneling Massacre
level_seven.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Banelings Barrage, but increase its cooldown by 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Nydus Network
level_ten.description: Summon a Nydus Worm on Creep anywhere that Zagara has vision. Zagara can enter a Nydus Worm and travel to any other Nydus Worm by right-clicking near it. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara regenerates 10% Health and Mana per second.  Stores up to 2 charges. Maximum of 4 Nydus Worms at a time.  Passive: Creep spreads 15% farther.  Passive: While on Creep, each Basic Attack reduces all of Zagara's cooldowns by 0.4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Hydralisk Transfusion
level_thirteen.description: Zagara is healed for 60% of the damage dealt by Hunter Killers' Basic Attacks to Heroes.

level_sixteen.title: Corrosive Saliva
level_sixteen.description: When attacking Heroes, Hunter Killers and Roachlings deal additional damage equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health.

level_one.title: Furious Blow
level_one.description: Every 4th cast of Seismic Slam deals 40% more damage to the primary target and costs no Fury.

level_four.title: Shattered Ground
level_four.description: Increase Seismic Slam's splash damage by 250%. Targeting a Hero with Seismic Slam further increases its splash damage by 250%, while targeting other enemies increases the length of its splash by 66%.

level_seven.title: Battle Rage
level_seven.description: Activate to instantly restore 10% of Sonya's maximum Health. Stores up to 2 charges. Usable while Whirlwinding.  Passive: Sonya deals 25% more damage to Mercenaries.

level_ten.title: Wrath of the Berserker
level_ten.description: Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.

level_thirteen.title: Mystical Spear
level_thirteen.description: Ancient Spear always pulls Sonya to the target location even if it doesn't hit an enemy. When used this way, Ancient Spear's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Giant Slammer
level_sixteen.description: Basic Attacks and Seismic Slam deal an additional 1.5% of Heroes' maximum Health as damage and heal Sonya for 60% of the damage dealt.

level_twenty.title: Striding Giant
level_twenty.description: Wrath of the Berserker increases maximum Health by 10% and grants Striding Giant, which can be activated to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds. 30 second cooldown.

level_one.title: Zealous Glare
level_one.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 70% more damage.

level_four.title: Subdue
level_four.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish increases the Slow to 70% and the Slow amount does not decay.  Quest: Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish.  Reward: Punish always Slows by 70%.

level_seven.title: Conviction
level_seven.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

level_ten.title: Falling Sword
level_ten.description: Johanna leaps into the air for 2 seconds and she can steer the landing location by moving. While in the air, allies below Johanna are Unstoppable. Upon landing enemies hit take 225 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Holy Fury
level_thirteen.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Each Hero hit by Condemn increases this damage by 40% for 5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Shrinking Vacuum
level_sixteen.description: Condemn reduces enemy Heroes damage by 30% and Slows by 30% for 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Heaven's Fury
level_twenty.description: Falling Sword rains down holy bolts, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemies, healing allied Heroes for 68 (+4% per level), and reducing its cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

level_one.title: Power Hungry
level_one.description: Regeneration Globes restore 100% more Mana and grant 10% Spell Power for 20 seconds.

level_four.title: Triumvirate
level_four.description: If Arcane Orb hits an enemy Hero after traveling at least 50% of its base range, the cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and 40 Mana is refunded.

level_seven.title: Zei's Vengeance
level_seven.description: Increase Arcane Orb's damage increase for distance traveled by 30%. Additionally, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

level_ten.title: Disintegrate
level_ten.description: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480 (+5% per level) damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

level_thirteen.title: Cannoneer
level_thirteen.description: When Li-Ming uses an Ability, her next Basic Attack's damage is increased by 75% and deals Spell damage instead of Physical. Stacks up to 3 times.

level_sixteen.title: Arcane Orbit
level_sixteen.description: Arcane Orb travels 25% farther, increasing its maximum distance damage bonus from 270 (+3% per level) to 371 (+3% per level).

level_one.title: Wave of Light
level_one.description: Quest: Damage or heal Heroes 60 times with Holy Radiance.  Reward: Increase the duration of Devotion by 0.5 seconds.  Passive: Damaging or healing Heroes with Holy Radiance refunds 5 Mana and reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

level_four.title: Holy Fire
level_four.description: Deal 13 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase this damage by 20% for 3 seconds. This can stack up to 3 times.

level_seven.title: Armor of Faith
level_seven.description: Being Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants Uther 90 Mana and causes Holy Light's cooldown to recharge 200% faster for 6 seconds. This effect has a 20 second cooldown.

level_ten.title: Divine Shield
level_ten.description: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Spell Shield
level_thirteen.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

level_sixteen.title: Tyr's Deliverance
level_sixteen.description: Increase the damage and healing of Holy Radiance by 10%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes cause Uther's next cast of Holy Radiance to have its damage and healing increased by an additional 10%, stacking up to 7 times.

level_twenty.title: Bulwark of Light
level_twenty.description: Divine Shield is also applied to all nearby allied Heroes and lasts 1 second longer.
